edits.current:
- name: Require nominal Rust packages on the pinned toolchain
        if: matrix.profile == 'rust'
        timeout-minutes: 45
        env:
          LEAN_NUM_THREADS: "1"
          CARGO_BUILD_JOBS: "1"
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          bash scripts/bootstrap-rust-ci.sh
          source scripts/env.sh
          bash scripts/run-nominal-subtype-rust-ci.sh "$PWD/.toolchains/rust-1.90.0/bin/rustc" "$PWD/.toolchains/rust-1.90.0/bin/cargo"
      - name: Preserve complete and partial nominal Rust records
        if: always() && matrix.profile == 'rust'
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v7
        with:
          name: nominal-subtype-rust-${{ github.sha }}
          path: build/nominal-subtype-rust-ci/
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 30

edits.previous:
Subtype fields in nominal records or variants, refined callback signatures and
owned Subtypes remain unsupported. These local runs do not measure dispatch
counts or establish hosted release-floor acceptance.

| `Subtype / {x // p x}` | `&BigUint, &BigInt, &str and &[u8], checked by the exported Lean validator and constructed by the adapter before dispatch; also in generated structural containers` (input); `the base value projected from the proof-backed Lean result; also in generated structural containers` (result) | Ordinary source: Installed checks passed (input, result); Not audited (field, callback input, callback result). Reviewed IR: Installed checks passed (input, result); Not audited (field, callback input, callback result) | Pass the primitive base value, including inside Array, List, Option, Prod and Except containers using their generated host representations. Each present Subtype leaf uses the selected checked Lean constructor; accepted normalization reaches the export. A rejected leaf fails the call without changing the input; later valid calls still work. Results expose the proof-backed base values. Transparent aliases and the tested closed List specialization keep their constructor choices. Required: Generate a checked constructor when validation is executable; require explicit decisions for non-decidable predicates. |

Reviewed IR: Installed checks passed (input, result, field); Not audited (callback input, callback result) | Pass the primitive base value, including inside Array, List, Option, Prod and Except containers using their generated host representations. Each present Subtype leaf uses the selected checked Lean constructor; accepted normalization reaches the export. A rejected leaf fails the call without changing the input; later valid calls still work. Results expose the proof-backed base values. Transparent aliases and the tested closed List specialization keep their constructor choices. In Rust, the tested acyclic records and variants use generated structs and enums with exact BigUint payloads for Nat Subtypes. Input functions borrow the generated values. Each input site keeps its selected checked constructor, including distinct normalizing choices for the same record. Copied results project existing Lean values without selecting or running an input constructor. Callers supply no proof fields. Required: Generate a checked constructor when validation is executable; require explicit decisions for non-decidable predicates. |

edits.previous: Copied results do not need an input constructor: Lean has already produced the proof-carrying value. Omit the result's `refinement` in an ordinary export contract, or omit `contracts` entirely for a result-only package with unrefined inputs. The adapter projects `.val`; it does not run a constructor on the output. Fresh [native](../evidence/subtype-result-20261011.md) and [component](../evidence/component-nominal-subtype-20261011.md) compiler checks cover primitive bases inside scalars, structural containers, aliases and acyclic plain records and variants. The shared component compiler no longer requires a result constructor selection. [Installed npm checks](../evidence/nominal-subtype-npm-acceptance-20261011.md) now cover the tested Nat results on both source routes, including standalone result-only packages. [Installed C/C++ checks](../evidence/nominal-subtype-native-acceptance-20261011.md) cover the same Nat result forms on both source routes, including standalone result-only packages, on Linux x64/glibc 2.36. [Installed Perl checks](../evidence/nominal-subtype-perl-acceptance-20261012.md) cover the tested Nat fields and constructor-free results on both source routes, with all four pinned ABIs, both installation modes and relocated replay on Linux x64/glibc 2.36. [Nominal Python checks](../evidence/nominal-subtype-python-acceptance-20261012.md) add those Nat forms on CPython 3.11 and 3.12 using the same reproduced wheel, offline installation and relocated replay. [Nominal Ruby checks](../evidence/nominal-subtype-ruby-acceptance-20261012.md) add those Nat forms on MRI Ruby 3.3.12 through reproduced gems, offline installation and relocated replay on Linux x64/glibc 2.36. Browser, other native hosts and PHP-Wasm installed acceptance for these additions remains pending.
